text.11 个从真实需要出发的小工具。终端、Android 调试、Codex 会话、桌: Eleven tools built for everyday needs. Terminals, Android debugging, Codex sessions, desktop shortcuts, break reminders, system diagnostics and a ruler in your pocket.

text.把重复的操作、零碎的麻烦，变成顺手的一下。: Less repetition. Fewer little hassles. One simple action.

text.告别堆满任务栏的命令行窗口。把 cmd、PowerShell 收进同一个窗口，多: Keep cmd and PowerShell in one window instead of crowding your taskbar. Tabs, flexible split panes, search and directory bookmarks stay close at hand.

text.按一下快捷键，常用软件出现在光标旁。不必回桌面翻找图标，还能扫描已安装的程序，批: Bring your favorite apps to your cursor with a shortcut. Skip the hunt for desktop icons, or scan installed programs and add them in batches.

text.每秒采样，保留最近 60 秒曲线。电脑卡完再打开，也能回看 CPU、磁盘和内存的: Sample every second and review the last 60 seconds. Even after a slowdown ends, check CPU, disk and memory activity to find resource-heavy apps.
text.给开发环境，腾一点空间。: Make a little room for your next build.
text.DevClean 缓存清理界面，容量及缓存为演示数据: DevClean cache cleanup interface with simulated capacity and cache data
text.开发者的 C 盘清理助手: A C: drive cleanup helper for developers
text.系统临时文件和开发工具缓存统一查看，按体积、风险分级列出。先看清楚占用在哪里，再: Review system temp files and developer caches in one place, sorted by size and risk. See what takes up space before choosing what to clean.

text.把手机屏幕变成毫米直尺。拖动两条测量线查看距离，横纵方向都能量，还支持用银行卡或: Turn your phone screen into a millimeter ruler. Drag two markers to measure horizontally or vertically, and calibrate with a bank card or coin.
text.专注一会儿，也让眼睛歇一歇。: A little focus. A little rest for your eyes.
text.EyeGuard 护眼卫士主面板，显示休息倒计时和今日用眼统计: EyeGuard main panel showing the break countdown and daily screen-time statistics
text.按时休息，给双眼留点余裕: Make room for regular screen breaks
text.默认专注 45 分钟、休息 5 分钟，用全屏遮罩提醒你停一停。支持远眺微提醒和蓝: Focus for 45 minutes, then rest for five by default. A full-screen overlay reminds you to pause, with optional distance-break reminders and blue-light filtering. Runs from the tray without installation.
text.看日志、翻文件、改代码，轻装上阵。: Logs, files and code. Travel light.

text.不用启动 Gradle 或加载项目索引。连接 adb，就能查看 Logcat、管: View Logcat, manage device files and edit local or device text files in tabs through adb, without starting Gradle or loading a project index.
text.换个关键词，或者看看全部工具。: Try another keyword, or explore all the tools.
text.小工具还会继续增加，慢慢做，慢慢用。: More small tools to come. Built and refined along the way.
text.喜欢折腾，也喜欢把折腾过的东西做成工具。: I like tinkering, and turning those experiments into useful tools.
text.这里收集了我最近做的 11 个小项目：让窗口整齐一点、操作少一点、问题更好查一点: These eleven recent projects help keep windows organized, cut down repetitive work, make problems easier to spot and remind you to take a break. If one of them makes your day a little easier, that's a good outcome.

features: Browse local Codex sessions grouped by day. Chat bubbles show messages, reasoning summaries, tool calls and recorded user images; reasoning and tool calls start collapsed.
Search within a panel or across sessions and jump to matching messages. Export Markdown, open raw JSONL files or follow local file links.
Continue a chat in Codex, or unarchive a session before opening it. Watches for record updates, follows the VS Code theme and parses everything locally.
codex-chat-history.requirements: Requires VS Code and local Codex session records. See the project README to build or install a VSIX. Reads CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex by default, with a configurable data directory. Continuing a chat requires the Codex extension or CLI; explicitly restoring an archived chat runs codex unarchive to change its archive status. Encrypted reasoning cannot be displayed. The extension interface is currently in Chinese.
codex-chat-history.caption: Demo image generated by the project from built-in fictional sessions, without real chats, accounts or personal paths.

features: Each tab and split pane runs its own shell process. Mix cmd, Windows PowerShell and PowerShell 7 when installed.
Split horizontally or vertically, nest panes and drag dividers. Use Ctrl + F to search and Ctrl + H for command history.
Directory bookmarks, saved transcripts, light and dark themes, and configurable fonts keep everyday actions in one window.
cmd-dock.requirements: Windows 10 version 1809 or later, x64. Releases include a self-contained build and a smaller build that requires the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime. The app interface is currently in Simplified Chinese.
cmd-dock.caption: Project demo screenshot using example directories and text.

features: Stream Logcat with level, tag, keyword and pid filters. Pause, copy or export logs, with automatic reconnect after disconnection.
Browse device directories, create folders, upload and download files, and open text files with a double-click. Permission errors are shown clearly.
Edit local and device files in tabs with syntax highlighting, search and replace, and Ctrl + S to save. Device writes preserve the original permission bits.
droid-studio-lite.requirements: Currently tested and packaged for Windows 10 / 11. Requires a working local adb installation and a device with USB debugging enabled and this computer authorized. See the project README for running and building. Android permissions limit device file access; the editor accepts files up to 8 MB. The app interface is currently in Chinese.
droid-studio-lite.caption: Screenshot from the built-in demo mode. Device serial numbers, models, third-party package names, internal IP addresses and product-related logs are replaced or hidden.

features: The tray number shows the remaining five-hour quota. A floating pill shows both five-hour and weekly quotas.
Drag the pill anywhere or dock it at a screen edge. Click to see percentages, reset times and the last update.
Refreshes every 60 seconds, with manual refresh, an option to hide the pill and launch at login.
codex-taskbar.requirements: Windows x64. The self-contained download runs without a separate .NET installation. Sign in to Codex locally first; the tool reuses that login. Values show remaining quota. The app interface is currently in Chinese.
codex-taskbar.caption: Project interface preview. Quotas are examples, not your live usage.

features: Detects project names from VS Code, Cursor, Unity, Visual Studio and File Explorer window titles, and groups windows automatically.
Drag windows between groups and reorder the groups. Manual rules are saved and reused after restarting.
Press Alt + F2 to show or hide the panel; the shortcut is customizable. Click a window to switch, or click outside to dismiss.
project-dock.requirements: A Windows desktop tool. See the project README for download and build instructions; building from source requires the .NET 10 SDK. The panel currently appears on the primary screen. The app interface is in Chinese.
project-dock.caption: Project demo screenshot. Project names and window titles are examples.

features: Press Alt + middle click by default to open a panel near your cursor. It avoids screen edges, and the mouse shortcut is customizable.
Add apps, shortcuts, documents, folders or URLs. Scan installed programs and Microsoft Store apps to add them in batches.
Launch with number keys 1–9, arrow keys and Enter. Optionally sort by recent use or launch at login.
quick-dock.requirements: A Windows desktop tool. See the project README for download and build instructions. The smaller build requires the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime; self-contained builds include it. The app interface is currently in Chinese.
quick-dock.caption: Quick-launch interface preview supplied by the project.

features: Press Alt + F3 to show or hide the note, or choose your own shortcut. The note takes focus when opened and stops staying on top when you switch away.
Saves automatically about 0.6 seconds after typing stops, as well as on focus loss and exit. Ctrl + S saves immediately.
Light and dark themes, a resizable window and plain-text editing. Each nonempty line appears as a separate, softly colored entry.
desk-note.requirements: Windows 10 / 11 x64. Releases offer a standalone package and a smaller package requiring the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime. Notes are stored locally in note.txt and can be backed up. The interface is Chinese; English text input is supported.
desk-note.caption: An illustration of the app layout in light and dark themes, using public example text. Not a real app screenshot.

features: Samples CPU, physical disk and memory activity every second. Keeps 60 seconds of history and lets you pause and step through it.
Groups resource usage by process name and lists the top five apps. Click an app to locate its executable in File Explorer.
Records freezes and sustained resource pressure automatically. The tray icon changes color with the load, without interrupting you with popups.
lag-lens.requirements: Windows 10 / 11 x64. Release archives include the .NET runtime. No administrator rights required. Use the conclusions as diagnostic clues alongside the recorded curves and load. The app interface is currently in Chinese.
lag-lens.caption: A slowdown scenario using simulated data. No real usage history or personal paths are shown.

features: Scans built-in, allowlisted system and app cache paths. Review size, risk level and required permissions by category.
Covers developer caches including npm, pnpm, pip, NuGet, Gradle, Cargo and Unity.
Shows paths, sizes and risks before cleaning. High-risk items need extra confirmation, and results list successes and failures.
dev-clean.requirements: Windows x64. Releases provide a self-contained executable with no separate .NET requirement. Some system items need administrator rights. Read the project instructions and check the impact of each selected item before cleaning. The app interface is currently in Chinese.
dev-clean.caption: Screenshot from the built-in demo mode. Disk capacity and cache figures are simulated.

features: Customize work and rest periods, with 45 minutes of focus and a five-minute break by default. The full-screen rest overlay covers every monitor, with optional skipping.
Optional 20-20-20 reminders suggest looking into the distance for 20 seconds every 20 minutes. A GPU gamma-ramp filter adjusts the display color temperature.
Runs in the system tray with pause, immediate breaks, daily screen-time statistics and optional launch at login. Settings stay on your computer.
eye-guard.requirements: Windows with .NET Framework 4.x. The single executable is about 86 KB and needs no installation. HDR, some graphics drivers and remote desktop sessions may not support the blue-light filter. If colors stay warm after forcibly ending the app, run eye-guard.exe --reset. The app interface is currently in Chinese.
eye-guard.caption: Actual main-panel screenshot from the project documentation, showing the break countdown and daily statistics.

features: Horizontal and vertical scales with draggable A and B markers. Read distances in millimeters or inches.
Nudge markers by 0.1 mm or 1 mm. Calibrate using a bank card, a coin or the actual dimensions of your display.
Calibration stays on the device. The screen remains awake while measuring; no network access or runtime permissions are required.
screen-ruler.requirements: Android 7.0 (API 24) or later. Download and install the APK. Check the scale against a card or coin first: reported DPI and display scaling affect accuracy. 0.1 mm is an adjustment step, not a guarantee of accuracy. The current APK uses the project's debug signature. The app interface is currently in Chinese.
screen-ruler.caption: Actual Android layouts rendered with Robolectric for the project documentation.
